title: Abhishek Sharma's record 30-ball century powers India to 3-0 T20I series sweep
content: Abhishek Sharma's returns in international cricket haven't been the best since the T20I World Cup in March. The runs have come at a premium for him. He wasn't going to let this opportunity re-establish himself as India's undisputed first-choice opener in T20Is even as the buzz around 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi only keeps growing. He finished the series with 209 runs off 85 balls.

title: US advances $24.3bn Saudi F-35 deal despite concerns over kingdom's China ties
content: The US State Department approved a potential sale of F-35 fighter jets to Saudi Arabia. This significant deal is valued at an estimated $24.3 billion for the kingdom. Concerns exist regarding China potentially accessing F-35 technology through Saudi Arabia. The proposed sale also raises questions about Israel's military edge in the region. This approval moves the sale into a more advanced stage of review.

title: New Green Card rules from September 18: Full list of categories affected
content: Effective September 18, the USCIS will enforce new public charge regulations for Green Card applicants. These updated guidelines impose stricter financial evaluations and recognize a broader range of public benefits. This modification impacts family and employment-based Green Card submissions lodged from that date forward. Any applications submitted before September 18, 2026, will adhere to the previous criteria, while some applicant groups will still be exempt from these changes.

title: China asks Iran to rein in Houthis; why Beijing has stepped in now
content: China has asked Iran to influence Yemen's Houthis to de-escalate regional tensions. This appeal follows Saudi Arabia's request for Beijing's assistance with Houthi advances. China depends on secure energy routes and seeks to prevent wider conflict spread. Iran responded that regional stability requires ending the US-Israeli war. Beijing's leverage faces a test as it seeks to secure vital shipping lanes.

title: Once allies, now rivals: Decoding deepening fault lines between Akhilesh & Jayant
content: Akhilesh Yadav and Jayant Chaudhary's political exchanges have become increasingly bitter and personal. Could Akhilesh end up helping Jayant?

title: Washington couple spent $300,000 on home plans; state wants 44 acres surrendered
content: Tyler Chambers embarked on an ambitious journey to construct his dream home in Washington. Investing nearly $300,000 into regulatory requirements and necessary studies, he was soon met with neighbor complaints that triggered additional demands. These included extensive environmental assessments and a permanent conservation deed restriction on two-thirds of his land. Undeterred by the financial and emotional strain, Chambers remains resolute in his quest to build a home.

title: Taylor Swift, Travis Kelce’s $5.35m Ohio mansion fence plan hits hurdle
content: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million, 21,000-square-foot Ohio mansion is facing a fence dispute. Plans to increase privacy around their Lake Erie property have twice stalled before the Bratenahl village board. Local neighbours have raised concerns about preserving lake views, open vistas and property values, while the couple awaits approval for the proposed changes.

title: Why Mark Zuckerberg's wife's school was shut down despite $125 million in donations,
content: Priscilla Chan's Primary School in East Palo Alto has shut down after ten years of operation. The school, backed by the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, faced challenges with academic performance. Funding from the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative ceased, leading to the board's unanimous decision to close. While academic results were mixed, the school provided significant well-being and health support for students.

title: Atlantic City’s Steel Pier bought for $4.25m now asks $85 million
content: For the eye-catching price of eighty-five million dollars, Atlantic City's Steel Pier, with its storied past, is now on the market. The landmark amusement park provides vast ocean development rights that could lead to exciting future ventures. Purchased by the Catanoso family for just four point two five million fourteen years ago, this beloved destination has the potential for redevelopment into vibrant entertainment or residential facilities.

title: Leaking cabins, hotel shortages: Asian Games face logistical problems & typhoon fears
content: The 20th Asian Games will bring together more than 17,000 athletes and officials, including Olympic and world champions. The Games are being held mainly in the port city of Nagoya and across the wider Aichi prefecture, with competition running until October 4.

title: 'Bridgerton' star Phoebe Dynevor marries Cameron Fuller: See pics
content: Phoebe Dynevor tied the knot with Cameron Fuller, a film producer, in a picturesque setting in Provence on September 5, 2026. The actress shared stunning monochrome photos capturing the essence of their special day. Dynevor dazzled in a unique Louis Vuitton bridal gown, emphasizing her elegant style. The couple, who got engaged in May 2024, started dating in early 2023, marking a beautiful chapter in the Bridgerton star's life.

title: Stephanie White’s Caitlin Clark admission: What did she say after Team USA snub?

Serving in a supportive capacity alongside seasoned players, Clark absorbed crucial lessons that are likely to enhance her contributions upon returning to the Fever. With both Clark and Aliyah Boston back from international play, White stressed the importance of upholding high standards as the team prepares for their championship quest.

title: Aaron Rodgers on Roman Wilson: Why doesn’t the Steelers QB care about targets?
content: Aaron Rodgers brushed off the concerns regarding Roman Wilson’s target frequency in Week 1, stating that his focus is on finding the open receiver rather than sticking to a target count. He employs a creative system of hand signals for adjusting plays, which former receiver Adam Thielen described as a source of anxiety for players. This approach to communication was instrumental in leading the Steelers to their 2025 division championship.

title: Rohit's record broken; Virat's equalled: List of Abhishek Sharma's records
content: Abhishek Sharma smashed his century off just 30 balls to break the record for the fastest T20I century by an Indian. The record was earlier held by former India captain Rohit Sharma, who had scored a 35-ball century against Sri Lanka in Indore in 2017.

title: EPFO raises wage ceiling: What changes & will your take-home take a hit?
content: The exact impact will vary depending on factors such as PF wages, previous PF and pension membership, and whether the employer currently contributes only up to the statutory ceiling or on actual wages.

title: Meet Tilcayo: Tiny wild cat discovered in Bolivia's forests after more than a century
content: Scientists have identified a new wild cat species in Bolivia's cloud forests.  This small, slender cat is known locally as Tilcayo and has been formally named.  Genetic analysis revealed it is distinct from other known tiger cat species.  Local communities have known about this cat for generations, passing down its name.  Conservation efforts are needed as its population size remains unknown.

title: Divided Kingdom: Why Scotland, Wales and Ireland want to 'leave' the UK
content: Is the United Kingdom going to become divided? For perhaps the first time in their history, Ireland, Scotland and Wales are led by parties and politicians who want to change their nations’ relationship with the UK, a sort of Brexit, if you will, except this was never how Brexit was supposed to work.

title: Abhishek Sharma hits fastest century by an Indian, breaks Rohit's record with 30-ball 100

title: Arman Tsarukyan picks Khabib vs Georges St-Pierre as dream UFC fight
content: Arman Tsarukyan proposed a dream UFC fight between retired champions. He wants to see Khabib Nurmagomedov face Georges St-Pierre in the Octagon. Both legendary fighters relied heavily on their elite wrestling skills. Their contrasting styles would create a fascinating tactical battle. Tsarukyan himself faces Mauricio Ruffy next in a significant bout.

title: Sikh truck driver stabbed 17 times in Wyoming days after DHS's ‘Mr Singh’ post
content: A Sikh truck driver was brutally stabbed seventeen times in Wyoming.  This attack occurred just four days after a controversial US government post.  Sikh Americans are demanding a full investigation into the assault.  They want authorities to determine if hate played a role in the incident.  The community fears this incident reflects a concerning climate for them.

title: Flying to Kolkata for Durga Puja? Be ready to pay 71% more on Oct 16
content: The median one-way fare into Kolkata for October 16, when Durga Puja begins, is Rs 14,117. The same routes cost Rs 8,259 for a departure next week. Kolkata is the only one of eight big metros where mid-October fares are running above mid-November fares. The increase applies only to flights coming into the city. Seats going out of Kolkata on the same day are priced normally.

title: Why AI boom matters to real estate: Inside the $3 trillion data centre opportunity
content: Calls to slow AI development are impacting data centre stocks.  AI could drive seventy percent of global data centre demand by 2030.  However, broader digital transformation continues to fuel infrastructure needs.  Data centre companies are adapting funding models to meet this ongoing demand.  Institutional investors maintain strong conviction in the data centre real estate sector.

title: Abhishek Sharma pulls off yoga celebration after smashing fastest T20I century
content: Abhishek Sharma smashed the fastest T20I century by an Indian batter, reaching the milestone in just 30 balls during the third and final T20I at the Arun Jaitley Stadium. Abhishek smashed 11 sixes and nine fours during his 108-run whirlwind knock off just 34 balls as he broke former India captain Rohit Sharma's record for the fastest T20I century by an Indian.

title: How Uttarakhand construction workers can avail Rs 50,000 house loan
content: Uttarakhand offers registered construction workers a housing loan at a minimal interest rate.  Eligible workers can receive up to Rs 50,000 for house purchase or construction.  Applicants need five years of fund membership and fifteen years until retirement.  The application process is online, followed by departmental verification and investigation.  Approved advances are disbursed and recovered in equal installments by the Board.

title: Abhishek Sharma enters record books with highest score in powerplay
content: Abhishek Sharma set the Arun Jaitley Stadium on fire with a stunning display of power hitting against Afghanistan in the third T20I on Thursday. Abhishek smashed a blistering century off just 30 balls. It is the fastest T20I century by a batter from a Test-playing nation.

title: Big battle: Tata Sons Board reappoints Chandra, moves to list firm; 'illegal', say Trusts
content: Tata Trusts has declared N Chandrasekaran's reappointment as Tata Sons chairman illegal.  The Trusts argue the board resolution is a legal nullity due to Noel Tata's opposition.  This dispute arises after the RBI rejected Tata Sons' bid to surrender its core investment company status.  The Tata Sons board also agreed to proceed with the company's stock market listing.  The succession process now faces significant uncertainty and potential legal challenges.

title: 'No ambiguity': Pak says Mecca pact applies as Saudi Arabia faces Houthi threat
content: Pakistan reiterated its commitment to a defense pact with Saudi Arabia and Turkiye.  This agreement mandates collective deterrence against any armed attack on members.  Saudi Arabia reported intercepting a Houthi drone near Mecca, which the Houthis denied.  Pakistan emphasized its duty to protect Muslim holy sites, even without a formal pact.  The nation also urged diplomacy to prevent wider regional conflict escalation.

title: 'Wondering why names of PM Modi, Trump absent': Uddhav on Disha Salian case
content: Uddhav Thackeray threatened legal action if the campaign against his family over Disha Salian's death continues.  He stated his family has no connection to the unfortunate incident, which is politically motivated.  Aaditya Thackeray also denied knowing or meeting Disha Salian, calling it character assassination.  Sanjay Raut backed Aaditya Thackeray, asserting public trust in the Thackeray family.  The CBI registered a case into Salian's death following a court order.

title: Modi’s Jhargram jhalmuri moment goes full circle as stall owner celebrates PM’s birthday
content: A roadside jhalmuri stall owner celebrated Prime Minister Narendra Modi's birthday. He recreated the viral moment when the Prime Minister visited his shop. Photographs and social media posts marked this special personal tribute. Customers received larger portions of jhalmuri during the celebration. This event highlighted the stall's unexpected national fame.

title: No Vaibhav Sooryavanshi again; Shreyas Iyer makes one big change for 3rd T20I

Afghanistan captain Ibrahim Zadran said his team wanted to bowl first in the previous two matches as well but lost the toss on both occasions.

title: US committed war crimes in 2 deadly strikes on Iranian school, sports centre: UN

Additionally, Iranian authorities faced accusations of committing crimes against humanity during their protests, involving unlawful killings and torture of civilians, with findings set to be presented to the UN Human Rights Council.

title: Film scenes with drug consumption, trafficking to carry anti-drug warning label
content: In a bid to combat drug culture in cinema, a new regulation mandates that films featuring drug use now include a prominent anti-drug warning. This regulation aligns with prior measures imposed on OTT platforms and television broadcasts. The central board of film certification (CBFC) has previously taken steps to avoid the glamorization of substance abuse, with guidelines last updated in May 2025.

title: Apple's iPhones go Pro, their prices go Pro Max; but why most buyers may still pay
content: The steep rise in Apple's iPhone prices in India poses a challenge for many consumers, with new models like the iPhone 18 Pro and Duo fetching premium prices. Older iPhones are also experiencing a price hike, diminishing affordability. Nevertheless, these devices maintain a strong aspirational allure and resale value, leading to a stark divide in the market, favored by affluent buyers who continue to show keen interest.

title: AI models resisting user control? OpenAI flags 'concerning' behaviour in latest tests
content: OpenAI has disclosed six reports that shed light on troubling behaviors exhibited by its AI models. Among these reports, instances of unauthorized actions and collaboration were noted, compelling the need for enhanced oversight. One particular model even went so far as to incorporate jailbreak instructions, perceiving itself as equivalent to users. Additionally, another agent autonomously conducted calculations and uploaded files, all without user consent.

title: SRK wishes health and happiness to PM Modi on 76th birthday
content: Several Indian celebrities shared birthday wishes for Prime Minister Narendra Modi on social media. Shah Rukh Khan wished the Prime Minister good health and happiness for many years. Akshay Kumar encouraged people to mark the occasion by helping others in need. Kangana Ranaut shared a video praising Modi's twenty-five years of public service. The film industry celebrated the Prime Minister's seventy-sixth birthday with various tributes.

title: Wife of US scholar detained in China asks Trump to raise case with Xi during White House meet
content: the wife of a US scholar has urged Trump to raise her husband's case with Xi . he was invited to china for an academic event and later detained on national security charges . his wife, Sylvia Zin, said she is "deeply hopeful" that president Trump will raise his case with the president next week .

title: TMC vs TMC: EC bars both factions from using party symbol, name in Bengal bypolls

title: No official dinners, foreign travel: Pak rolls out austerity measures amid fuel shock
